analyst_view.overall: Borac (21st, 3 pts) host Atalanta (16th, 4 pts) in a game both need for a top-24 place; Borac have won five of their last six in all competitions and are unbeaten at home in Europe, while Atalanta drew 4-4 with Inter on Sunday. Atalanta are without keeper Marco Carnesecchi (meniscus surgery this week, counted, Sportiello starts), centre-backs Hien and Kossounou (only individual work on Tuesday) and third keeper Pompei. With Lecce away on Monday, Sarri is expected to rotate heavily: Rowe, Scamacca, Raspadori, Samardzic and Sulemana are in line to start, with De Ketelaere likely on the bench. Borac only have Cipetic to be assessed. Belgian referee Nathan Verboomen has no usable record in the numbers.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.2 goals, about 2 of them Atalanta's, already lifted for Borac's recent scoring and for Carnesecchi's absence (+6%). Hien and Kossounou have been out for weeks, so recent form carries that, and a rotated attack with Scamacca and Raspadori instead of the first-choice front line pulls the other way, so I stay at about 3.2.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.6 corners, about 6 for Atalanta, already raised for Borac conceding plenty of corners lately (+7% for Atalanta). A rotated Atalanta still plays the same wide game with wing-backs like Bellanova, so I stay at about 9.6.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.1 cards and already raise Borac's share about 19% for their recent bookings. A home side chasing a stronger team tends to foul more, but that is what the numbers already show, and referee Verboomen has too little record at this level to point either way, so I stay at about 4.1.

shots.text: The numbers say 32.1 shots, 19 of them Atalanta's, already lifted for both sides' recent volume. I lean slightly lower: after a draining 4-4 with Inter and with Lecce on Monday, Sarri is expected to rotate heavily and may manage the game rather than chase it, which the numbers can't see. A mild -3% gives about 31.1 shots.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 10.7 shots on target, already raised for both sides' recent accuracy. A stand-in keeper and Borac's open defence point to chances at each end, which the numbers count, while a rotated Atalanta attack may be a little less sharp; those roughly cancel, so I stay at about 10.7.
